name: VPN
description: Universal VPN: WireGuard client and server with QR, OpenVPN, IPsec IKEv2, Tailscale, Headscale and ZeroTier, with kill switch, DNS protection and split tunnelling
capabilities: WireGuard server to reach home from outside, with QR codes for phones
Safe import of WireGuard and OpenVPN files
IPsec IKEv2, Tailscale, Headscale and ZeroTier
Kill switch and DNS leak blocking
Split tunnelling for included or excluded networks
